title: FIG. 05 · The signal loop
summary: Your clean A plate now carries B's signal loop and its 'How it closes' list, drawn with C's routing-sheet precision. The loop reads left to right along one signal line, the red return runs underneath and closes it last, and lettered tags A–D tie each part of the loop to its row in the list. In this final pass the section lost its side note and its link, so it no longer echoes the stack section right above it.
addressed: A's clean feel is kept. The head is unchanged ('Three layers. / One closed loop.'), there is one wide, quiet plate with plenty of empty space, and A's Open → Closed story stays: the small title block reads Open while the loop draws and switches to Closed when the red return lands.

B's chart is now the figure, with its stations, big light 01–03 numerals, the dashed 'Reroute effort' line, market signal in, compounding pipeline out and the red return path. It is laid out as one straight signal line (Narrative → Channels → Intelligence) with the return running underneath, so it reads left to right, the way you read the page.
B's 'How it closes' list sits beside the chart (Define · Activate · Measure · Retune) under its own heading. It opens in place, one row at a time, and opening a row lights its part of the loop.

C adds the precision without the clutter. Lettered tags A–D sit on the loop and match the list rows, each row shows its route (In → 01, 01 → 02 …, with the arrow drawn so it always renders in the brand type), and the reroute arches over the line the way C's routing sheet drew it. There is one measured line ('One cycle · one quarter') and a small title block. There are no spec tables, no cell IDs and no tiny text: labels on the drawing are 14px, and nothing is under 11px.

The logo symbol is gone from this section, including its shape. The mark-as-circuit is retired, and the loop no longer forms the logo's right-angle corner (round-1 B drew its red return as 'the mark's right angle'). The figure is a plain signal loop whose one red element is the return path from Intelligence back to Narrative.

The motion follows the reading order. The line draws left to right (A → B → C) while the matching tag and row light up, each station clicks on as the line reaches it, and the red return draws last, closing the loop. After that, one small signal slowly circles the loop.

Final coherence pass: the stack section directly above already ends on a side note at the right and a quiet link under its list. Repeating both here made the two sections feel stamped from one template, so this section drops its 'Yours to keep' note (ownership is the 'What you own' section's line) and its 'See how we install it' link (the reframe already links to the method). The loop is the whole act now.

reference.site: Round 1 · A + B + C (architecture A 'The mark as circuit' × B 'The signal loop' × C 'Signal routing sheet')
reference.borrowed: From A (Sunday's 'infrastructure behind the intelligence'): the composition, meaning a two-line head over one wide, flat plate with a figure on one side, a quiet list on the other and a caption in the corner. From B (FREITAG's cycle sheet): the loop of numbered stations with big light numerals and names hung from the nodes, the dashed second feedback ('reroute effort'), the red return, and the 'How it closes' list as rows that open in place. From C (Ada's system schematic): the routing-sheet topology, with one straight signal line, the return routed underneath, the reroute arched over the line and terminals at both ends. C also gives the lettered tags on the wires keyed to the side list, the route codes and the title block.
reference.kelwin: The figure is DIRECTION-AC's TRACE primitive, not the logo. It is one orthogonal signal line on the plate with the stations on column lines (01 = col 3, 02 = col 5, 03 = col 7), market signal in at the left edge and compounding pipeline out to col 8. The red return path (the section's one red element) runs from 03 down, under the line and up into 01, and the dashed reroute arches over 02–03. The loop is a closed rectangle (U-shaped red return, straight white line, ∩-shaped reroute), so no part of it forms an L-corner, a nested corner or a core square. It has three 7px station nodes that latch as the line reaches them, one open chevron per segment and one 6px packet. Selection uses --fg only: the selected segment brightens, its kit code box inverts and its row title goes to --fg. Retune also thickens the red return and lifts the reroute. C's quotas hold: 4 lettered tags (≤ 5), 1 dimension line (≤ 2), 1 title block of 4 cells, 0 registration marks (the drawing sits in a plate) and about 21 annotation words. Callout labels are Mona 14, and mono is used only for codes, the dimension value and the title block. 'How it closes' is a kit .ac-h3 ledger-group head (32px), so the list reads as the section's second act. The band under the plate holds only the title block, so the reading path ends on the closed loop and the open Retune row. Built on kit-ac: .ac-head, .ac-plate/.ac-field/.ac-capband, .ac-tblock, .ac-h3, .ac-ledger/.ac-row/.ac-toggle, .ac-callout__code, .ac-dim, .ac-num, .ac-plot, .ac-cascade.

motion: entrance: the margin-to-margin hairline draws (graphite follows graphite) and the kit's head choreography runs: label, then the two statement lines rising from their masks, the 48×2 red rule and the lede. The plate rises 12px and fades in (420ms, 700ms). The 'How it closes' head and the caption band fade in at 900ms, and the four rows cascade at an 80ms stagger.

the one orchestrated moment (TRACE: draws, latches, closes, in reading order): the three stations are staked out as outlined 7px nodes and the title block reads 'Open'. From 800ms the signal line plots left to right (stroke-dashoffset, ease-in-out). First A, market signal → 01 (450ms); 01 latches from outline to filled at 1.25s and its numeral, name and descriptor rise. Then B, 01 → 02 (650ms), with 02 latching at 1.9s. Then C, 02 → 03 (650ms), with 03 latching at 2.55s. While each segment draws, it lights in --fg and its tag and row light with it. The dashed reroute arch fades in over 02–03 (2.65s) and the output runs out to 'Compounding pipeline'. At 2.95s the red return draws last (1000ms): down from 03, back under the line and up into 01, with the D tag appearing as the line passes it. As it lands (≈ 3.95s) the title block flips Open → Closed, row D · Retune opens in place (360ms) and the dimension 'One cycle · one quarter' draws (600ms). Everything is settled by ≈ 4.7s.

ambient: one 6px packet then laps the closed loop at constant speed (12s per lap, linear) for as long as the section is in view. It starts at 03, rides the red return into 01, then runs the signal line back to 03. It is the section's only loop.

interaction: the list is the one control and really works. Clicking a row opens it in place (exactly one open) and lights its segment and tag. Retune thickens the red return to 2.5px and lifts the reroute. Hover and keyboard focus preview a row's segment and return to the open row on leave. A click during the demo stops it. The kit hover applies to the rows (the title nudges 6px).

on the live site: the drawing plays once when the plate is 40% visible (IntersectionObserver), with no pin. With reduced motion the markup renders the final state synchronously (loop closed, D · Retune open, packet resting on the red return) with no timers and no loop.
notes: The stage is about 1245px: 128 / 128 padding, the kit head (88px statement, a 3-line lede at 46ch, no note), 64px to the plate, and a 536px plate (a 480px field and a 56px band). The figure sits in cols 1–8 and the list in cols 9–12 (24px inset). The band carries only the title block. Geometry is shared by the SVG viewBox (0 0 1312 480) and the HTML overlays through field variables (--x1 --x2 --x3 --yt --yr), and the packet rides a CSS offset-path on the same loop. Route codes draw their arrow as a 1.5px mask (the kit's → path) because the shipped JetBrains Mono subset, like Google's latin subset, has no U+2192; a typed → fell back to a system font. Red: the label square and rule (family punctuation) plus the return path and its chevron; there is no red button. Row copy was lightly edited so that no row repeats the lede word for word (Retune: 'What intelligence learns flows back each quarter, retuning the narrative and rerouting effort.'). Station descriptors are round-1 source copy. Page-level coherence: like the stack directly above, this section uses B's opening list in cols 9–12, as DIRECTION-AC prescribes. Here it sits inside the plate under its own heading with lettered codes, and the section carries no note and no link, which keeps the two neighbours apart.
